svg.title: Verdicts
svg.desc: Hungary lap 39, hards: within range. Hungary lap 54, used softs: outside range, 5.1 points lost. Silverstone lap 39, left out under the safety car: inconclusive. Monaco laps 18 and 21: not assessable at the time. Hindsight outcomes are listed separately on each card.
